svg.title: CH13 M05 — cross one whole on a line numbered audit markup
svg.desc: Baseline preview with numbered callouts mapped one-to-one to audit findings. Production revisions and retained decisions are recorded in the audit.
svg.text: 05 · M05 — cross one whole on a line
Arcs float above the line with endpoints shifted five pixels
from the actual ticks. Their purple marker heads also obscure
Briefs and ledger still describe fifteen separate jumps
although the accepted art uses two grouped moves.
Baseline markup only · See audit for revision targets, acceptance checks, and final resolutions.
